page.overview:
Who is Nailea Shaffat?

Nailea Shaffat was educated at the Suk Medical School.

Shaffat was approached by the Prisoner at her clinic in Arrakeen. She asked why they had come and they told her that they were investigating the death of Osten Laithe and that they suspected foul play. She asked them about the state of the cadaver and they told her that they found froth around the mouth, which made her suspect poison. She told them to acquire a poison snooper to confirm this suspicion, for she did not have one at present.
